title: Evaluation lower-bound preservation
statement: Let P be a coefficient evaluation derived package on the pro-etale site of T. For every n, M, and integer a, M.IsGE a implies ((P.evaluation n).obj M).IsGE a.

proof.text: Evaluation is exact and commutes with the standard truncation defining IsGE; apply the supplied system evaluation calculus.

proof_origin.place: Separated boundedness/construction step from Zheng Construction 4.1 and Lemma 4.10; Stacks 09B1.

lean.statement:
theorem exceptionalSiteOriginComparison_evaluation_bound
    (O : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing O] (ell : O)
    (T : Scheme.{u})
    (P : CoefficientEvaluationDerivedPackage.{u + 1, u, u + 1, u + 2}
      (J := Scheme.ProEt.topology T) (O := O) (ell := ell)) :
    ∀ n M (a : ℤ), M.IsGE a → ((P.evaluation n).obj M).IsGE a
